definitions.explanation: Not heavy, easy to lift or carry. The opposite of {重|おも}い (heavy).
Can describe something that is not serious or intense, like a light meal or minor injury.

examples.japanese: このかばんは{軽|かる}いです。
{軽|かる}い{食事|しょくじ}をしました。

notes: The opposite is {重|おも}い (heavy). {軽|かる}い can be used figuratively: {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い (loose-lipped), {軽|かる}い{気持|きも}ち (casual feeling/not taking seriously). {軽|かる}く考える means 'to take lightly'.
